description: Patterns for credentials newly minted by an upstream and returned in a response. Applied to responses from hosts that a credential is bound to. Regexes are Python 're' syntax over decoded text; group 'secret' (or the whole match) is the credential.
source: Rules marked gitleaks are taken from https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/blob/5f6ec56cfa6f8c67648d863582c7ae2f206d5c1c/config/gitleaks.toml (MIT). Length quantifiers on GitHub token bodies are widened from {36} to {36,255} because GitHub documents that token lengths may grow.

rules.note: Format observed in third-party Copilot clients (tid=...;exp=...;...). No first-party documentation.
Generic: any JSON token field on a bound host, whatever its format.
Generic: form-encoded OAuth token responses (GitHub's default for /login/oauth/access_token).
